status: EXAMPLE ONLY - not verified against any state's contract form. Replace with a profile built from your state's current form and reviewed by your broker or an attorney before real use.

deadlines.label: Earnest money delivered to escrow
deadlines.meaning: Your good-faith deposit must reach the title/escrow company by this time.
deadlines.action: Deliver the deposit to the title company. Confirm wiring instructions by phone first.

deadlines.label: Inspection period ends
deadlines.meaning: Last day to complete inspections and act on the results under the contract's inspection terms.
deadlines.action: Schedule inspections early. Tell your agent what you want to do before this deadline.

deadlines.label: Seller response to repair request expected
deadlines.meaning: If a repair request was made, the seller's response is due by this time.
deadlines.action: Review the buyer's repair request with your agent and respond in writing.

deadlines.label: Title commitment review ends
deadlines.meaning: Last day to object to issues found in the title commitment.
deadlines.action: Read the title commitment with your agent. Raise any concerns before this date.

deadlines.label: Appraisal deadline
deadlines.meaning: The appraisal should be completed and any appraisal contingency resolved by this time.
deadlines.action: Confirm the appraisal is ordered and on schedule.

deadlines.label: Loan approval deadline
deadlines.meaning: Last day under the financing terms to obtain loan approval or act on the financing contingency.
deadlines.action: Send every document your lender asks for the same day. Don't open new credit or change jobs.

deadlines.label: Homeowner's insurance bound
deadlines.meaning: Your lender needs proof of insurance well before closing. This is a practical target, not a contract date.
deadlines.action: Choose a policy and send the declarations page to your lender.

deadlines.label: Final walkthrough
deadlines.meaning: A last look at the home to confirm its condition and any agreed repairs.
deadlines.action: Book a time with your agent.

deadlines.label: Closing
deadlines.meaning: Signing and funding at the title company. Bring a government photo ID.
deadlines.action: Title will confirm the exact time and the final amount due.
